content.text: One continuous 8-second live-action historical-film insert, starting from the supplied empty daytime tent cot. Keep the same coarse grey bedding, pale tent cloth, hanging dark armour, daylight direction and restrained natural colours. The camera is the receiving person's eyes beside the cot, tilted down toward the near edge of the bedding. Faces and bodies stay outside the frame; only two people's hands and forearms enter. At 0–1 seconds hold the quiet empty cot edge with subtle real camera drift. At 1–3 seconds a right hand in a coarse grey linen sleeve enters from screen right and offers one small letter folded into a closed palm-sized cream paper rectangle over the cot edge. The side facing the camera is completely plain unmarked paper. At 3–5 seconds the receiver's left hand, in a darker coarse linen sleeve, enters from the lower left and grips the near left corner. Show a clean physical handover: both hands touch the same single folded letter, then the offering fingers release and withdraw to the right. At 5–8 seconds the receiver draws the closed letter gently toward the lower-left foreground and holds it; keep its plain outer back facing camera. Never unfold, rotate to an inked side, duplicate, vanish or exchange the letter again. All fingers remain anatomically coherent and the paper moves only where the hands contact it. No readable marks, handwriting, labels, text, captions, graphics, information cards, blur patches or masks anywhere. Do not add a third person, a face, a weapon, a new document or an object on the bedding. No frozen frames or repeated motion. Permitted spoken utterances: NONE. Absolutely no speech, narrator, whispering, singing or other human voice. No BGM or music. Only synchronized faint cloth and folded-paper rustle and quiet daytime tent air.
